title: A spawn warns when the brief asks a role to edit a path it cannot write
why: A test-author briefed to edit docs/debts/notes.md is refused by its role guard, which wastes one agent round and leaves the step half done.
note: Filed 09:26 CST Nov 8 from lane timing-tests (session_013NEJL1jPC89ae6X6Pa4jmf, its own mistake, twice today). Guard idea: when the Agent tool is called with subagent_type test-author or builder and the brief names a docs/ or record path to edit, warn the orchestrator before the spawn. One home: read the role's write paths from the same constants the role guard uses.
